items.title: "Your Idol" Boards
items.summary: Two sci-fi mercenaries attempt a sting operation on a cyborg trafficker that's moonlighting as a casino's star singer. However, it ends up taking a show-stopping turn, as one of the mercenaries decides to try and steal the spotlight for herself.Watch the animatic version on my YouTube! (@joshquatch2980)https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vj5Hg8FWXc4All characters and art belong to Joshua A. Manning. Inspired by and using lyrics from the song "Your Idol" from "K-Pop Demon Hunters", specifically the cover by Annapantsu.
